'''Amasashinowake Shrine''' (あまさしのわけじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in Fudōhigashimachi 4-chōme, {{ill|Tokushima (city)|Q207309|qid=Q207309}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}.

=== History ===
The date of its founding is unknown. It is a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=shikinai shrine}} listed in the *{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}*. Originally, it enshrined Hikosashikatawake no Mikoto, a son of {{ill|Emperor Kōrei|Q313041|qid=Q313041}}. Later, his mother, Ofuyamato Kuniare-hime no Mikoto, was {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=enshrined by invitation}}, and it is said that Kamimusubi no Mikoto and Takamimusubi no Mikoto were subsequently enshrined together. It was formerly a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=village shrine}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* {{ill|Kamimusubi|qid=Q3275901|lt=Kamimusubi no Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Takamimusubi|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi no Mikoto}}
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Hikosashikatawake no Mikoto}}
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ofuyamato Kuniare-hime no Mikoto}}

=== Shrine crest ===
* Sixteen-petal chrysanthemum

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
* There are about ten subsidiary shrines, including Wakamiya Shrine, Kotohira Shrine, and Yasaka Shrine.
